Otto’s High Dive.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
Otto’s High Dive.verification: Reused from the already-verified magical-dining-orlando-2026 guide (see guidePickPhotoManifest.js). I re-opened the actual encoded file at /home/claude/wf/public/guides/picks/magical-dining-orlando-2026/ottos-high-dive-milk-district.webp and viewed it directly: it is a brick corner building whose vertical sign reads 'OTTO'S High Dive' next to painted 'ABUNDANCIA Neighborhood Rum Bar' signage on the same facade, confirming this is Otto's High Dive itself, not a different bar or the Abundancia business. The Commons file's own description independently reads "Otto's High Dive, a Cuban restaurant and rum bar in Orlando, Florida." Not geotagged. Licence CC BY 4.0 as recorded in the manifest.

Kaya.note: Restaurant pass (2026-09-23): Checked 25 Commons candidates for 'Kaya', all noise (Burkina Faso market-town photos, a Turkish carnation flower, Dutch 2025 election-list PDFs, a Singapore 'Kaya Toast' shop), none the Orlando restaurant. pass3-reuse.json's 'Kaya' entry is a false Kaya->Kayak match to a Sarasota mangrove-tunnel photo, correctly ignored per the brief. Openverse queries 'Kaya restaurant Orlando' and 'Kaya Filipino Orlando' returned zero results; this small, newer Filipino restaurant has no CC-licensed photo online.
